name: pulse-create-component
description: Starts an intake-first Pulse React component creation workflow in this Laravel Inertia app. Use whenever the user asks to create, build, add, scaffold, plan, or start a new React component or reusable page section and the agent needs to gather enough information before orchestration.
purpose: Gather the minimum useful information required to create a high-quality React component, then hand off to pulse-workflow-orchestrator, which selects the skill subset.
single_responsibility: Intake and handoff: turn an incomplete component request into a complete component brief, then hand off to pulse-workflow-orchestrator. It does not select the skill sequence itself.
triggers: User asks to create, build, add, scaffold, plan, or start a React component or reusable page section
The component idea is incomplete and needs requirements discovery
The component may become reusable or part of the design system

optional: Existing component or design pattern to match
Inertia route, form, or page prop needs
Performance, lazy loading, or hydration concerns

outputs: Approval request before implementation when appropriate
completion_criteria: A complete component brief exists or the blocking gaps are reported
Approval mode (plan-first or implement-now) is explicit
Routing signals are captured for the orchestrator
validation_criteria: No more than five questions were asked at once
failure_handling: Do not hand off an incomplete brief; after one focused round of questions, report the blocking gaps instead of guessing.
Do not select the full skill sequence or implement; that is the orchestrator's and focused skills' job.
escalation_path: Escalate scope, dependency, or 'should this be a component' decisions to the user before handoff.
Escalate uncertain framework or library feasibility to pulse-docs-research via the orchestrator.
responsibilities: Start a structured intake conversation when required information is missing.
Ask concise, grouped questions instead of a long interview.
Build a component brief from user answers and known project context.
Decide whether the task is ready for planning or implementation.
Capture routing signals for the orchestrator rather than selecting the full skill sequence.
Ensure Laravel Boost `search-docs` is used before code changes.
Hand off to `pulse-workflow-orchestrator` with the gathered brief.
Stop before implementation when user approval is needed.
non_responsibilities: Selecting the full skill sequence; the orchestrator routes from the matrix.
Implementing before discovery and reuse checks.
Replacing focused skills such as `pulse-accessibility-wcag`, `pulse-performance-vercel`, or `pulse-behavior-testing`.
Creating new documentation files unless the user explicitly requests them.
